notes.title: XBPlay Update: Ending Support
notes.content: [p]I wanted to share an important update with you all. After a lot of thought, I’ve decided I will no longer be able to support XBPlay.[/p][p align="start"]This has been such a fun and rewarding project, and it’s only been possible because of all of you. Your feedback, ideas, and encouragement over the years have meant so much to me. I never imagined XBPlay would reach so many people, and I’m truly grateful it could be part of your gaming experience.[/p][p align="start"]The app will remain available until Sep. 30, at which point I will unpublish it.[/p][p align="start"]Happy gaming :)[/p]

- Improved login flow by disabling passkey auth on deck and adding QR code method.
- Added vulkan render pipeline as an option in the main menu settings. Reduces latency and battery but disabled clarity boost.

- Added in-game side menu -> games list
- Add xhome shortcuts
- Set default login mode to oauth for new users

[list]
[*] Added translations.
[*] Fixed issue with creating shortcuts on some Windows devices.
[*] Fixed auto-login + oauth settings combo causing cloud shortcuts to break.
[/list]

Please help with translations if you can: https://crowdin.com/project/xbplay

Add all categories
